scope: Actual occluder selection, per-renderer ownership, stable fade/recovery
bugs_fixed: Camera-space AABB minimum depth and projected overlap came from unrelated corners, falsely fading a wide warehouse behind the hero.
One district marker grouped unrelated props, fading loading crates and barrels when any building member matched.
Projection rectangles treated holes in a combined mesh as opaque geometry.

runtime.query: Finite near-plane to torso-front segments, exact readable mesh triangles via balanced BVH; bounds prune only.
runtime.cache: One BVH per unique mesh per camera, rebuilt only on topology refresh; freed on disable. No added colliders or per-frame mesh array reads.
runtime.grouping: Independent MeshRenderer by default. IntercomOccluder.fadeWholeHierarchy is explicit opt-in only for one building.
runtime.unsupported: Unreadable or skinned occluder meshes remain solid. New imported static scenery needs Read/Write enabled.
runtime.scene_migration: None required: existing marker fields default fadeWholeHierarchy=false.
